description: Multi-Constellation Analysis of Public MGEX Clock Data

methodology.data_source: Public MGEX combined CLK files (COD0MGXFIN from CODE, with WUM/GRG fallbacks) from NASA CDDIS
methodology.key_innovation: Independent product and epoch analysis of MGEX combined receiver-clock solution
methodology.processing: Receiver-clock offset extraction from AR records, phase-alignment spectral analysis, no positioning
